clients.title: Client configuration
clients.description: Reuse providers across clients. Switch and restore each client independently.
clients.restoreDescription: Undo AgentHarbor's managed fields while preserving other settings. Reopen the client session afterwards.
clients.claudeCodeHint: Uses an Anthropic Messages provider. The default model and Opus, Sonnet, and Haiku aliases all point to the selected model.
clients.opencodeHint: Adds compatible models from all enabled providers while retaining existing providers. Switch with /models in OpenCode.
clients.limitsHint: Model metadata is preferred; unknown limits start at 1M / 8192. Adjust to provider limits. Other models with missing metadata use these defaults.
clients.noProviders: Enable a provider with a compatible protocol first.
clients.localHint: Requests use AgentHarbor's local router and record relay token usage. Keep AgentHarbor running and reopen client sessions to apply changes. Project settings or launch arguments can override global settings.
clients.backupHint: Other fields are preserved and a backup is created. JSONC is normalized to JSON; the full original text is retained in the backup.
clients.restartHint: Reopen the client session to use the new configuration.

errors.unsupported: This client does not support this configuration entry. Use routing injection above for Codex.

errors.notConfigured: AgentHarbor has not configured this client.

newapi.title: Relay Inject
newapi.description: Configure relay models for Codex; enable smart routing to switch freely in the model menu.
newapi.smartRoutingDesc: List official models + relay models together in the Codex desktop app and the Codex extension, with free switching.
newapi.routingOnHint: Enabled: the menu includes official models and every enabled relay. Requests without a selected model use the first enabled relay.
newapi.routingOffHint: Disabled: Codex keeps its official configuration. Add a relay below, test connectivity and pick a default model before enabling.
newapi.routingApplied: Smart routing written to Codex config
newapi.accountlessTip: When on, Codex does not require an OpenAI account and only uses relay models.
newapi.accountlessHint: Off: use your real account ｜ On: no OpenAI account needed, relay models only
newapi.groupAliasPrompt: Enter an alias for this relay site
newapi.groupAliasDescription: All model groups under this site share the alias.
newapi.empty: No relays yet. Add a site, test connectivity, then inject it into Codex.
newapi.balanceNotQueried: Not queried yet; refresh to auto-detect
newapi.testSucceededBody: Sent hi through {{model}} and received a successful response.
newapi.testDialogDescription: Choose a model and AgentHarbor will send a real hi request. The card is marked reachable only after that request succeeds.
newapi.testRequestHint: This request uses the “{{mode}}” network mode.
newapi.networkDirectShort: Bypass the proxy for this site
newapi.networkProxyHint: This relay now follows AgentHarbor's global proxy setting.
newapi.networkDirectHint: This relay now connects directly without a proxy.
newapi.networkUpdated: Network mode updated; test the connection again
newapi.deepSeekPeakTip: DeepSeek peak/off-peak pricing: peak 9:00-12:00 / 14:00-18:00 (UTC+8); all other hours and whole weekends are off-peak at half price.
newapi.name: Name
newapi.urlHint: Use the site home page URL; a path ending with /v1 also works.
newapi.userIdHint: Numeric user ID from a NewAPI profile; only needed for balance queries. Leave blank for Sub2API.
newapi.accessTokenHint: NewAPI or Sub2API account access token for balance queries. It is never used as the model API key.
newapi.apiKeyHint: Create an sk- key on the site's token page; used for calls and model listing.
newapi.addModelPlaceholder: Enter a model ID and press Enter
newapi.emptyModelLibrary: Fetch models from the site or add a model ID manually.
newapi.codexCatalogHint: Every selected Responses model is added to the Codex model menu. The round marker only chooses the initial default. Restart Codex after saving.
newapi.otherClientCatalogHint: These models are available to compatible client configurations. Codex custom providers currently support Responses only.
newapi.protocolHint: Choose the protocol exposed by this relay. Codex smart routing uses Responses providers; Chat and Anthropic providers are available through the matching local proxy endpoint.
newapi.contextHint: Fill in only after confirming the model supports it; leave blank for Codex defaults.
newapi.compactHint: Must be smaller than the context window; leave blank to let Codex decide.
newapi.confirmDeleteBody: This removes the local configuration and credentials of “{{name}}”. The Codex config is updated on the next change while smart routing is on.
newapi.storageHint: Credentials stay on this device. Windows protects them with DPAPI; macOS and Linux store them in an owner-only local file. While smart routing is on, keep AgentHarbor running.

customInstructions.title: Custom Instructions
customInstructions.description: Manage Codex global custom instructions through ~/.codex/AGENTS.md without touching project-level AGENTS rules.
customInstructions.templatesDescription: Built-in templates are available now and admin-managed templates can be attached later.
customInstructions.currentDescription: Only the AgentHarbor managed block is shown here. Other handwritten global rules are preserved.
customInstructions.editorDescription: Edit on top of a template, then apply only to the AgentHarbor managed block in the global AGENTS file.
customInstructions.editorPlaceholder: Edit the content that will be written into the managed global custom-instructions block
customInstructions.historyDescription: Recent local apply records are kept here so you can roll back quickly.
customInstructions.globalScopeHint: Only manages the AgentHarbor block inside global ~/.codex/AGENTS.md
customInstructions.noManagedContent: There is no AgentHarbor managed block yet.
customInstructions.clearedManagedContent: This action will clear the AgentHarbor managed block.
customInstructions.clearConfirmDescription: This only removes the AgentHarbor managed block from ~/.codex/AGENTS.md and preserves any other global rules you wrote yourself.
customInstructions.templatesLoadFailed: Failed to load remote templates. Falling back to built-in templates.
customInstructions.loadFailedDesc: Try again later, or check your network and refresh the page.
customInstructions.previewDescription: This only updates the AgentHarbor managed block inside ~/.codex/AGENTS.md. It does not touch project code or project-level AGENTS files.
customInstructions.applySuccessDesc: The AgentHarbor managed block was written to ~/.codex/AGENTS.md.
customInstructions.clearSuccessDesc: The AgentHarbor managed block was removed from the global AGENTS file.
customInstructions.rollbackSuccess: Rolled back to the selected history
customInstructions.rollbackSuccessDesc: The selected history version replaced the current AgentHarbor managed block.
customInstructions.rollbackFailed: Failed to roll back custom instructions

maintenance.cleanDesc: Remove redundant auth backups, registry backups and stale snapshot entries to free disk space.

maintenance.restartCodexDesc: Terminate and restart the local Codex process to apply config changes or recover from errors.
maintenance.restartConfirmDesc: This will terminate the current Codex process and restart it. Any ongoing operations may be interrupted.

update.title: Update Available
update.installBlocked: AgentHarbor cannot install updates from the current location. Reopen it from the real installed app path and try again.
update.installBlockedReadOnlyLocation: AgentHarbor is currently running from a read-only location, so self-update cannot replace the app bundle. Move AgentHarbor to Applications or a real local folder, reopen it from that path, then try again.
update.installBlockedAppTranslocation: AgentHarbor is currently running from macOS App Translocation in a read-only mount, so self-update cannot write the app bundle. Move AgentHarbor to Applications or a real local folder, reopen it from that path, then try again.
update.installPromptDesc: AgentHarbor is currently running from a temporary macOS read-only location, so future updates will fail. Move AgentHarbor into Applications, then reopen it from the real installed app path.
